findings.severity: medium: before the public launch (the customer sees it); not a privacy issue
findings.what: The cost of ת55's full page loads, A/B against my S17 build (same cart code): (1) every entry into the cart shows 'סל (0)' and 'הסל ריק.' with the room picture until the cart loads: 361 ms locally, 1,086 ms with an 800 ms cart API; the checkout says 'הסל ריק, אין מה לשלם.' for 219 / 980 ms (S17: 0); the prerendered /cart/ is the empty cart; (2) without storage (localStorage throws) the cart page is empty after an add (S17 kept it in memory); (3) an add still on its way when the cart is clicked is lost (S17 finished it).
findings.fix: (1) while a saved cart id is loading, the cart, the checkout and the header count show a quiet loading state (aria-busy), never 'ריק' or '(0)'; the empty state only when there is no id or the API says so. (2) without storage, carry the cart id in the full load's fragment (/cart/#c=<id>, read, then removed with replaceState; a fragment reaches no server and no referrer). (3) cart writes with fetch keepalive, or the cart link waits for a pending add (up to ~2 s).

findings.what: ת52's word boundaries count '_' and digits as letters, so a customer's name glued to them in a provider's text stays in a known order's row: 'consignee_dana_rejected: address [customer]', 'dana1985', 'DANA_GAT', 'DanaGat'. S17's strip removed them.
findings.fix: Boundaries by letters only: (?<!\p{L}) … (?!\p{L}) (error_id and order_id are already kept by their shape). Optional: split camel case.

findings.what: ת53's system-code door: a provider error's own code shaped like a system code (/^E[A-Z0-9_]{2,40}$/, e.g. 'E_ORNA') becomes error_code and reaches the supplier.submit_failed row.
findings.fix: A closed list of system codes (ECONNRESET, ECONNREFUSED, ECONNABORTED, ETIMEDOUT, ENOTFOUND, EAI_AGAIN, EPIPE, EHOSTUNREACH, ENETUNREACH), else the status or 'Error'.

findings.what: Question 1: rule A matches flat pictures by the emptiness of their hash, not by likeness: our 220 near-blank files and flat inked ones (canvases, depth maps) sit about popcount(picture) bits from every supplier picture; today 27 from the vase (popcount 30). One supplier picture with popcount ≤ 24 would fail every public build that ships such a layer.
findings.fix: P3: plain-vs-plain A only when d ≤ (popcount a + popcount b) / 2. Measured: 0 true copies lost; P1 as proposed is safe but only 27 → 30.

notes.what: ה8 residual: 11 of my 20 new denials still read 'הדפס במרקם': 'w/o texture', 'w/o embossing', 'texture-less', 'texture: N/A', 'Texture: Smooth', 'texture: flat', 'Embossed: N', 'Textured: False', 'isnt textured', 'doesnt have texture', '(texture? no)'. No card says any of them; the build list (1 product today) is the backstop. Cheap: add w/o, -less, isnt/doesnt/dont, and read '<texture word>: <no | n | none | n/a | false | smooth | flat | 0>' as a denial.

ת51's known limits (checklist 1.5, the S19 README): crop into the picture, rotation, upside-down. Add: a flip with a colour change (R9c passes; 67/78 in the study) and one tile of a collage (R21). The gate's code header names what it catches but not these.

Analytics undercount (owner decides): after the cart, and after an order, in-site browsing stays in a document without the beacon, so those page views are not counted. If it matters: a move from a page without the beacon to one with it is a full load too.

e2e under load: the encoding spec failed twice in the full run (load 12–14) and passed alone with the baseline numbers, as in S18. A capture that waits for idle frames, or a retry for the encoding spec, would keep the CI quiet on a busy runner.
